verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-driven wallet and payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only single-item flows: one order intent, one checkout run, one onramp or offramp order. Nothing shows batch endpoints, bulk wallet creation, or multi-item operations. Generic phrases like "move company funds at scale" and "multiple rails" per order intent do not describe acting on many items at once.
